body:
The first time I smoked pot I was 16 years old and one month after my first toke I was dealing it.  I guess you could say that says something about my character like I go to extremes.  My older cousin Jake, who was in his twenties introduced me to my first hit and a half of blotter about but reflecting now I didn't understand LSD then, let alone benefit from it.  Then came the mushrooms that I still like to munch on from time to time. But, I will never forget my introduction to Microdot Acid.  It is above all the best trip I have ever had with no comparison to blotter and much more pleasant than liquid.
It was the summer of 1999, I was 17, and one night with Jake and a guy named Keith, we split a double barrel microdot 3 ways and snorted it.  It burned like hell!  I had to be home for some reason or other so I cruised home so focused on the possibility of my parents being up when I got home that the effects on the way home escape me.  I remember sneaking down to my room and smiling and laughing to myself as I twisted the lock to by bedroom door.  My parents room was right above mine so I didn't dare to turn on the lights to my room in fear of my parents seeing it and coming down to ask me why I was home so late on a school night (I had summer school despite being quite bright because I loved getting high and fucking off every day at school).  Anyway, I was enjoying the colorful show of the darkness and wanted to be able to see.  So I found myself crawling around on the floor tweaked out of my mind laughing and looking for a lighter.  I finally gave up and tried to get some sleep as I marveled at the drug.
[Erowid Note: 
Driving while intoxicated, tripping, or extremely sleep deprived is dangerous and irresponsible because it endangers other people.
Don't do it!
]
After that teaser, that very weekend, Jake, Keith, Ben and myself set out to score some Dots.  Ben had a hookup, so we climbed in my '97 Jeep Wrangler, with the top off, to pickup the 50 hits we ever so excitedly desired.  We had driven to the dealer and Ben came back with a big ball of tinfoil.  Ben opened it for a peak as we drove off and picked out one for each of us to eat so we could be trippin' by the time we got back to his apartment.  I have become a master at tripping and driving.
The apartment was groovy.  It seems funny to use that word but the apartment belonged to a docter in the sixties and it had green shag rugs, a few mirrored walls, and the other walls were wavy white plaster with sparkly specs in it.  It also had cheap chandeliers and windows overlooking the Main Street of our town from the second story, in the dart room.  I want to emphasize town because the population is only about 10,000 or so.  We also climbed on the roof of the place from time to time where on occasion Jake would run and jump off, turn, and grab the edge.  He's a crazy fucker.  But don't paint too awesome of a picture of what this place is because ben didn't take care of it very well.  It was very dirty.  Ben's bathroom became notorious for cocaine and acid.  The police watched us like hawks up there especially because ben loved to crank his stereo.  On account of all the shit that went down there and the vibe you get when you're there, we now call it, 'The Devil's Den'.
Getting back to the story, a few people had been waiting there for us to return and the atmosphere was quite menacing.  We snorted some lines in the bathroom when a guy named Chad and myself decided to get out of there for a while.  We wanted to go to the store to pickup some spring water.  We got the Fire Cheif's daughter to bring us.  It was quite ironic.  This goody-goody girl, who was ugly at that, was giving two people high on acid a ride to the store to buy water.  She had no clue what was up.  We climbed in the car and it became quite humorous for us.  The energy of the car was intense and it seemed to hover across the pavement.  The lights of passing cars and street lights were incredibly intense.  I was loving it.  It felt great to get out of that place and the acid for a little while.  Chad and I had been exchanging glances of amazement but as we neared the store where the local kids hang out, he turned to me and said, 'oh yeah, I got that for you,' and handed me that ever so familiar ball of tin foil.  It was like a cold wave of air swept over my body and went straight up my ass.  I couldn't believe it.  I had all the shit in my hand and as I glanced out my window across from the store and a police car was sitting there watching the hooligans at the store.  I told Chad to make it snappy in the store because paranoia was coming on strong.  He grabbed the water, got back in and we hovered on back to the apartment where we were greeted with pure chaos.
Ben came right up to me and said, 'We gotta get out of here man, I can't stay here.'  I told them that my parents were away for the weekend and we could go to my house.  My house was pretty sweet too.  I made it clear that on my trip to the store the cops had been out and driving just wasn't a cool idea at this point.  So we called a taxi for the eight of us.  Shortly after, a van taxi showed up with an old man for a driver and his wife who was along for the ride that night.  We all piled in, half of us failing to hold back our laughter.  As we got underway, I made the observation that the cab seemed like a futuristic space shuttle of some sort.  The windows were glazed with a colorful tint and energy was all around us.  I was seeing everything as a form of energy.  I could feel the energy of the streetlights and power from all around me.  Someone had been passing around a pair of oversized ski-glasses that gave everything an orange tint and the curvature of the huge lenses super-intensified the lights.  They put you right in, 'The Zone'.  I was sitting there unable to imagine what this old couple could possible thinking at this point.  We were acting far different than a group of drunks.  Ben just couldn't help himself from harrasing the driver and his wife and Chad's girl friend was bitching about getting cigarettes before we got to my house.  We all terminated that idea immediately.  I had known right then that I would never forget that cab ride.  We got out into the country towards my house and people were getting a little more vocal and rowdy.  Occasionally I would say, 'Just ignore them,' and I would repeat the directions.  I had to do this because Ben would say shit like, 'We're going straight to the fucking moon tonight!'  We finally got there and all piled out.  One kid fell right on his face and we all tried not to laugh but I shot straight for the door.
My house kicked ass to party at.  The original portion of the house is a log cabin style place of good-sized porportions which mainly consisted of a living room with a high ceiling, a bathroom, a bedroom for my little sister, a loft, and a bedroom in the loft.  Through an archway was the newer portion of the house which had regular sheetrock walls but had about 10 large windows that overlooked the back yard and there is door leading onto the deck.  Also in the kitchen is a staircase leading down to the half finished basement to a pool table room, my room and the unfinished portion was a wood shop.The pool room has doors leading out back where two high powered flood lights,once mistaken for a fire, lit up the back yard.  In the back yard, which was surrounded lightly by trees was a horse shoe pit, a swing set, and a fireplace.  With all the wood grain, surround sound stereo, and other good shit, this place was tripper heaven.
You could probably imagine the sense of security, peace and happiness as we found ourselves away from town, the police and other uninvited guests.  We immediately broke out the lines of microdot again and got on the phone so we could call up a few other good friends to join the party.  Before long, there were people everywhere.  Pool table balls were streaming across the table, the tunes were kickin', and the horseshoes were flyin'.  It was great.
Playing horseshoes created an incredible tracer display.  To my surprise, people were actually getting ringers and doing all right.  The same went for playing pool, we weren't playing half bad and it was fun to watch.  At any rate, when trying to concentrate, I would feel myself breathing heavily and the most incredible euphoric feeling as if my spirit were taking flight.
I remeber a few instances very clearly.  Keith was standing by the Pioneer stereo system that was cranked as high as it would go but it could barely be heard.  I could only hear this very high tone of the music which seemed to be floating and very unstable.  Perceptual distiortions were very clear and extreme at this point.  Keith's head was lopsided!  That isn't even the fucked up part.  I wasn't the only one to make this observation.  Besides that, microdot always made colors take on a very distinct, weird shade.  While noting this, I would think about how funny life is and embark on my journey seeking out what really matters in life and 'What it is all about'.
I also remember coming up the stairs,from playing horse shoes,to the kitchen only to find Ben standing at the long dark blue counter top with underwater goggles on, holding a sand box hoe that he was using to chop up gigantic lines of microdot with.  It was hilarious and the afterburn from those took a while to get over.
Jake had been walking around with a Bart Simpson doll with a gun in it's hand saying, 'Give me all your meatbird!', to all the women.  Meatbird is what we called women or pussy.  The women we knew actually called themselves meatbirds.
When reading this experience you must also consider that this was the first time we REALLY did microdot and many had a lurking fear deep within.  Jake found one girl losing her mind in my bathroom.  I overheard a Chad and his girlfriend talking about how they thought they might die.  None of us were really educated on LSD.  We had sayings like, 'That last line went right out the back of my fucking head!!!'.  A person not used to tripping at all might feel some discomfort after hearing that or, 'I can feel my brain frying right now.'  I know that I had a philosophy that I swore by and still do that,'It's all in your head.'  Many others swear by it as well.  Also well known is, 'It's all good'.
I had the time of my life.  My golden retriever had been tripping as well.  I went for a run with it and glanced over to see that it too was having the time of it's life.  It got intoxicated from everyone petting it and the sweat from their hands emitting the LSD onto the dog.  Another occurrance was that out of this huge group of alcoholics, throughout the night, I saw people drinking Hi-C juice boxes and orange juice despite the beer in the fridge.  This was the greatest experience of my life and I know that not one other person who was there will ever forget it and I only wish I could grasp words to describe the flight I took that night more clearly for you all.
Thank you for listening to my experience!
